subject.title: Bound trajectory pointer file read with size cap

question: Should the focused trajectory-only branch remain the landing candidate, or should https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/110516 own this exact cleanup change as part of its larger batch?
rationale: Both open branches implement the same file-level behavior, and neither has positive real-behavior proof sufficient to make the broader branch a safe automatic replacement.

options.title: Keep the focused trajectory fix
options.body: Recommended: use this narrow branch after it adds real behavior proof, and remove the duplicate `cleanup.ts` edit from the broader PR.

options.title: Consolidate into the broader batch
options.body: Move this exact fix and its proof into https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/110516, then close this branch only after that PR is proof-positive and remains viable.

recommendation.title: Keep the focused trajectory fix
recommendation.body: Recommended: use this narrow branch after it adds real behavior proof, and remove the duplicate `cleanup.ts` edit from the broader PR.

likelyOwner.reason: The same contributor authored both the focused branch and the merged bounded-read precedent, making them the clearest person to resolve the duplicate branch scope.
